triggers.name: c2_handoff_package_before_insert
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER c2_handoff_package_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.handoff_event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION c2_populate_handoff_package_tg()

triggers.name: c3_enrich_handoff_from_memory_before_insert

triggers.name: trg_hf3_handoff_refresh
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hf3_handoff_refresh AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF escalation_rule, handoff_reason ON public.handoff_event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hf3_handoff_refresh_trigger()

policies.using: ((company_id IS NOT NULL) AND is_company_member(company_id, auth.uid()))

policies.name: handoff_event_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((conversations c
     JOIN company_membership cm ON (((cm.company_id = c.company_id) AND (cm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (cm.is_active = true))))
     JOIN company co ON (((co.id = cm.company_id) AND (co.is_active = true))))
  WHERE (c.id = handoff_event.conversation_id)))

policies.name: messages_select_staff
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversations c
  WHERE ((c.id = messages.conversation_id) AND (c.company_id IS NOT NULL) AND is_company_member(c.company_id, auth.uid()))))
